'''Selif Xam''' was a [[Kallidahin/Legends|Polis Massan]] physician who lived and worked in an archaeological research station on [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Xam was part of a team investigating ancient ruins on the asteroids<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|340}}</ref> formed during the destruction of the original Polis Massa planet.<ref name="DB-Polis Massa">{{DB|location|polismassa|Polis Massa}}</ref> When [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] was near death and brought into the facility, it was Xam who led the medical team to deliver her unborn children. Despite possessing limited knowledge of [[Human/Legends|Human]] birth, Xam reprogrammed his medical droids to assist him in the delivery.<ref name="CSWE" /> Although Padmé could not be saved, they did succeed in saving her twins, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]].<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref>
